# Turn a Teachable transactions export into a Xero or QuickBooks journal

> Turn a Teachable transactions export into month-split journal entries. Nothing leaves your device.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/teachable-payout-to-journal/)
